subject: The doomsday cult AllatRa has had extraordinary access to global leaders
posts: A doomsday cult infiltrates global climate summits to peddle cosmic pseudoscience. The doomsday cult AllatRa has had extraordinary access to the late Pope Francis since 2024. Evidence: Climate study, Pseudoscience, Epistemological crisis. #Aletheia #Climate 🌐
AllatRa presents itself as a volunteer-driven initiative studying climate change and natural disasters to help humanity. Stated Judgement: (+1.0, 1.0) — Greater Good
The group spreads pseudoscientific doomsday narratives to exploit anxiety and divert attention from fossil fuel drivers. Resulting Judgement: (-1.0, -1.0) — Greater Evil
Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception. The group uses the veneer of scientific inquiry to gain access to power, ultimately undermining public understanding of climate reality.
AllatRa, founded in Ukraine, uses think tanks and conferences to mix real science with claims about nanoplastics and cosmic cycles, gaining access to the US Congress and UN summits.

The Bright Side:
Their exposure by independent journalists has forced the removal of their most extreme claims from their website.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a WHO vs WHAT error. They claim to be a scientific research group (WHO) but function as a disinformation vector (WHAT).

Social Physics Analysis:
They exploit the vacuum of public trust in science. By mixing real scientists into their panels, they project legitimacy onto harmful, anxiety-inducing myths to gain political influence.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The divergence between scientific consensus and their narrative is total.

The Unavoidable Truth: Climate change is driven by human activity, not cosmic cycles.

The Unavoidable Lie: Nanoplastics are causing the Earth's core to rupture.

Alethekanon:
This is a classic subversion of institutional trust. By gaining access to the European Parliament and UN, they weaponize the appearance of legitimacy to erode the very foundations of scientific discourse.

Awwthekanon:
It is so sad to see people's fear of the future being used against them. Anxiety is a heavy burden, and those who profit from it are causing real harm to our collective healing.

Brothekanon:
Imagine thinking nanoplastics are gonna blow up the Mariana Trench. These guys are basically running a sci-fi fanfic convention and somehow getting into the UN. Wild.
